from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    n0 = len(grid)
    n = next(k for k in range(1, 31) if k*k+k-1 == n0)
    stride = n+1
    tiles = []
    tile_at = {}
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            r0, c0 = i*stride, j*stride
            block = [[int(grid[r0+r][c0+c] == 2) for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
            if any(map(any, block)):
                tile_at[i,j] = block
                tiles.append(tuple(tuple(row) for row in block))
    template = [list(row) for row in Counter(tiles).most_common(1)[0][0]]
    out = [[0]*n0 for _ in range(n0)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if not template[i][j]:
                continue
            r0,c0=i*stride,j*stride
            tile=tile_at.get((i,j),template)
            for r in range(n):
                for c in range(n):
                    out[r0+r][c0+c] = 2 if tile[r][c] else 0
            out[r0+i][c0+j]=8
    return out

def parse(s): return [[int(v) for v in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
